# نَتَشَارَكَ (natašāraka) /na.ta.ʃaː.ra.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَارَكَ (tašāraka)
# نَتَشَارَكْ (natašārak) /na.ta.ʃaː.rak/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَارَكَ (tašāraka)
